_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, credit cost, expense, nonperforming-asset and pre-tax margin signals with JPMorgan Chase's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading financial services firm based in the United States' 'Unfavorable market and economic conditions can have an adverse effect on JPMorgan Chase’s wholesale businesses.' 'JPMorgan Chase operates in a highly competitive environment in which it must evolve and adapt to the significant changes as a result of changes in financial regulation, technological advances, increased public scrutiny and changes in economic conditions.' (FY2021 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other internet-based companies, financial technology companies'; it says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other products and services, including deposits and other traditional banking products, could be significantly disrupted by the use of new technologies, such as cryptocurrencies and other applications that use secure distributed ledgers, that require no intermediation'; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and scoped to banks and payments: these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for JPMorgan Chase

theme_watch.reason: Live: JPMorgan Chase's own FY2021 10-K says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other products and services, including deposits and other traditional banking products, could be significantly disrupted by the use of new technologies, such as cryptocurrencies and other applications that use secure distributed ledgers, that require no intermediation'. The stock trades at 11.8x FY23E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of JPMorgan Chase's payments and banking specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading financial services firm based in the United States' 'Unfavorable market and economic conditions can have an adverse effect on JPMorgan Chase’s wholesale businesses.' 'JPMorgan Chase operates in a highly competitive environment in which it must evolve and adapt to the significant changes as a result of changes in financial regulation, technological advances, increased public scrutiny and changes in economic conditions.' (FY2021 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other internet-based companies, financial technology companies'; it says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other products and services, including deposits and other traditional banking products, could be significantly disrupted by the use of new technologies, such as cryptocurrencies and other applications that use secure distributed ledgers, that require no intermediation'; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and scoped to banks and payments: these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for JPMorgan Chase. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.94x; +31% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.21; conservative 2yr +37%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -21.3%/yr (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +20.7%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.7%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: JPM (retrospective, 2023-02-17) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.94x (48.9% downside to Bear $72.65 / +52.2% upside to Bull $216.48) | Adj composite 2.46 vs market 2.24: gap +0.21 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +31% above the EPP floor $108.81 (9x FY23E $12.09) | Conservative 2-yr case: +37.4% total (+18.7%/yr) | At 11.8x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $188.11 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +18.1% YoY in Q4 2022, forward revenues +18.1% (Q4 2022 revenue growth (no Q1 2023 guide)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
